## next

1. H: read the pileup performance report of the 18:01 cron
   (`docs/plans/*_pileup-perf-investigation.report.qmd`; scratch
   `/bioproj/t/20261125.agent.sam-tagger-pileup-perf`), then choose the
   speedups to implement.
2. M: ecsngsqc migration to sam-tagger must target 0.8.0: drop the
   `amplification_primer_*_seq` columns from the generated config (rename to
   `amp_primer_*` in the same change) and pass `--fasta` to the AP rules (S31
   annotate + any qc-summary call).
3. M: wps_1012 adopts v0.8.x (env pin): add error-stats `--fasta` and AP-rule
   `--fasta`, migrate qc-summary `_pct` column reads to `_rate`, and switch the
   S37_1 explicit-flags workaround to `--prefix`.
4. M: pin the suite invocation to the dev env (or add pytest to the
   default env) — bare `pixi run test` resolves pytest from the global
   pixi bin and fails at collection.
5. M: decide whether supplementary (0x800) records count in read-level
   metrics (total_reads/FL/on_target/AP); base-level metrics keep them.
6. M: implement the chosen pileup speedups in sam-tagger with an equality
   test against 0.9.0 outputs on the S34_1 BAMs.

## recommendation

1. H: ecsngsqc: drop or repair the 27 misplaced R1 records (fwd, POS 1,
   NM>=20, AS~len — e.g. at S23) — they manufacture the N-heavy error
   profile reported as mismatches.
2. M: report the bwa-mem2 placement defect upstream with the local repro
   recipe (fwd read, true window at ref pos 2-4 -> POS 1 + wrong MD/NM +
   kept AS; scripts in /tmp/samtagger_debug/).
3. M: ecsngsqc: compute the S34_1 pileup once — `ap_both.bam` differs from
   `annotated.bam` by 31,336 of about 99.7 M records (0.03 %), so the
   second 3 h run adds almost nothing; emit AP-both columns in one pass
   or drop the second run.
4. M: add a `to_n` column (or N split) to error.parquet so pairloom-
   unresolved N calls stay separable from true substitutions.
5. M: submit sam-tagger 0.9.0 to bioconda — `recipes/sam-tagger/meta.yaml`
   is sha256-ready; use the conda-recipes `upload-to-bioconda` skill.
6. L: on future releases, expect the release workflow to auto-create the
   GitHub release on tag push — use `gh release edit` for curated notes
   instead of `create`.
7. L: run `ruff format` on changed files only — the repo is not format-clean
   under the current ruff, and blanket runs rewrite unrelated files.
